findings.title: _pause_project_workflows still has db.commit() inside derive chain
findings.description: Residual from prior B-1. _pause_project_workflows() is called from derive_project_cost() via _check_budget_enforcement(), and still commits the transaction. This breaks the caller's transaction boundary — if the caller expects to roll back on failure, the pause is already committed.
findings.fix: Remove db.commit() from _pause_project_workflows(). Let the caller's get_db() context manager handle the commit.

findings.title: Budget enforcement TOCTOU race condition (carried from Run 1)
findings.description: check_budget_before_new_work() is advisory — no locking mechanism. Costs can increase between check and launch.

findings.title: collect_task_cost silently swallows all failures (carried from Run 1)
findings.description: All exceptions caught and logged as warnings. No alerting or metrics for persistent cost collection failures.

notes: 4 of 5 prior BLOCKERs fully fixed. 1 residual BLOCKER (db.commit in _pause_project_workflows). 2 WARNINGs carried forward unchanged.
